extraction.name: FOMO60K
extraction.description: A large-scale, heterogeneous dataset of 60,529 brain Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) scans from 13,900 sessions and 11,187 subjects, aggregated from 16 publicly available sources.
extraction.creator: Asbjørn Munk, Stefano Cerri, Jakob Ambsdorf, Julia Machnio, Sebastian Nørgaard Llambias, Vardan Nersesjan, Christian Hedeager Krag, Peirong Liu, Pablo Rocamora García, Mostafa Mehdipour Ghazi, Mikael Boesen, Michael Eriksen Benros, Juan Eugenio Iglesias, and Mads Nielsen
extraction.citeAs: To ensure proper attribution and recognition of the source datasets we kindly ask all users to cite the following papers: OASIS1, OASIS2, BraTS24, MSD Braintumor, IXI, MGH Wild, NKI.
extraction.rai:dataCollection: FOMO60K is derived from 16 publicly available datasets. The dataset aggregates clinical- and research-grade imaging, including multiple MRI sequences (T1, T2, FLAIR, DWI, T1ce, PD, SWI, GRE).
extraction.rai:dataCollectionMissingData: In cases where sequence information is unavailable, scans are generically named scan_X.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Aggregated from 16 publicly available sources: MGH Wild, SOOP, BraTS-GEN, OASIS1, OASIS2, MSD Braintumor, IXI, NIMH, DLBS, IDEAS, ARC, MBSR, UCLA, QTAB, NKI, and AOMIC ID1000.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: MRI preprocessing comprised three main steps: reorienting images to RAS (Right-Anterior-Superior) orientation, affine co-registration, and skull-stripping. Scans were reoriented and affinely co-registered using mri_coreg from FreeSurfer 7.4.1. Within each session, scans were aligned to the image with the highest spatial resolution. For 4D DWI scans, b=0 volumes were extracted separately, and for the b=1000 shell, three volumes aligned with x, y, and z axes were averaged into a single 3D image. Skull-stripping was performed using SynthSeg (FreeSurfer 7.4.1) only when images were not already defaced or skull-stripped by the provider, or when visual inspection identified residual cranial features.
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: The dataset will continue to grow in future releases as additional cohorts and modalities become available.
extraction.rai:personalSensitiveInformation: Residual cranial features that could compromise anonymization. To protect privacy and prevent easy identification of dataset sources, subjects have been shuffled.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Intended to support the development and benchmarking of self-supervised learning methods in medical imaging at scale. The dataset can be used with no further pre-processing for pre-training.
